instruction: Candid lifestyle photograph, medium vertical shot. In a cozy bedroom with floral wallpaper, a family shares a playful moment. The bearded man in a white t-shirt and striped pajama pants (R1) planks on a woven rug, looking up at the camera with a wide, joyful smile. Sitting on his back, the woman in a white button-down shirt and white pajama pants (R3) smiles while holding the blonde toddler in striped pajamas (R2). The toddler stands on the planking man's lower back, supported by the woman. Soft, natural light illuminates the warm-toned room.
